findings.expected: The contract must make its clean-build and clone evidence satisfy the task's every-file checksum requirement, or obtain an explicit Coordinator scope/contract amendment before claiming an exception for mutable caches. Duplicate-only inspection of cache does not prove byte equality.
findings.minimal_repair: Specify and rehearse a complete pre-start manifest over all .next files; compare T2's clone against that complete manifest before outage. If runtime cache writes prevent C11 from comparing the live tree against a pre-start all-file snapshot, state a separate safe live verification rule without describing a partial comparison as byte-for-byte whole-build proof. Keep production stopped/rollout blocked when required verification fails.
findings.observed: The shared manifest command excludes every file under .next/cache. C8, C11 and rollout T2 then call equality with that partial manifest proof of the clean build or clone. Changing a cache file's bytes leaves the manifest unchanged; a synthetic cache-byte mutation confirmed this. The task's CLEAN-EVIDENCE check requires every .next file path and SHA-256 so the clone can be proved byte-for-byte identical.

regression_proof.description: On a synthetic .next with server and cache files, record the exact proposed manifest, alter one cache file byte, and require the clone verification to reject it; also require a changed non-cache byte and a planted duplicate to reject.

findings.expected: A C11 failure must have an explicit safe terminal state consistent with the cleanup's restore guarantee: stop the rebuilt service, restore the moved-aside build, restart and verify service, keep the rollout blocked, and report; or seek an explicit change to the failure contract before claiming that every failure restores.
findings.minimal_repair: Update the C11 failure row and sequence to use the established bootout/restore/bootstrap/health-check path, keeping the contaminated build for evidence and leaving ROLLOUT-2A3BC-2 blocked.
findings.observed: Section 4 calls the moved-aside build the restore point for every failure, and the reported contract says failure always restores it, but the C11 artifact-mismatch row leaves the altered rebuilt .next serving and defers a decision. C11 is the final cleanup pass condition, so this is a failed cleanup with no prescribed restoration of the known serving build.

regression_proof.description: Walk through a synthetic C11 checksum mismatch and verify that the documented steps restore the moved-aside build and reach /login 200 while the rollout remains blocked.

notes: Frozen SHA/tree and two-file scope verified; git diff --check and local secret-pattern scan clean. Coordinator verify OK. No production contact or tracked changes during review. Rehearsal and gate receipts were reported green; findings concern the written safety contract.
